full_name: Kirsten Weld | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 History Joy Foundation Fellow Harvard University
bio: Kirsten Weld is a historian of Latin America who researches the politics of revolution and counterrevolution—and how these are remembered. At Radcliffe, she will finish a book manuscript on the impact and legacies of the Spanish Civil War in Latin America and the Caribbean from the 1930s through the present.
